author: WP01
summary: The title page frames the work as a revision-bounded account of CNA, a C++23 reimplementation of the XNA 4.0 programming model, pinned to a development snapshot with its last tag and product version. The identity facts (snapshot, tag, product version) are already on the site's releases page; the book title, edition name and author credit are book furniture.

concepts.text: The work presents itself as a revision-bounded technical account of CNA and its surrounding foundation, content, renderer and verification projects, grounded in pinned source, tests and retained records.
concepts.note: Book title-page framing (title, edition name, author, year); the site's equivalent framing is its per-page evidence box and the snapshot pin, so nothing technical is lost.

concepts.text: Three identities are stated separately: the CNA source snapshot, the last relevant tag, and the product version that the TARGET tree still reports (0.1.0-alpha.1).

target.evidence: CMakeLists.txt (project VERSION 0.1.0, CNA_VERSION_PRERELEASE alpha.1); tag v0.1.0-alpha.1
